register_map.notes: Register pointer with auto-incremented burst reads; write to pointer then repeated-start read is recommended.

raw_encoding.notes: Pressure and temperature are 20-bit unsigned values stored in 3 bytes; humidity is 16-bit unsigned stored in 2 bytes.

init_sequence.notes: After power-on reset, sleep mode is selected by default; all registers are accessible.
Wait until im_update clears after power-on-reset before relying on NVM-derived calibration data.
If configuring humidity, write ctrl_hum first and then write ctrl_meas for the change to become effective.
If configuring the IIR filter, be aware that writing config resets the filter memory.

read_sequence.notes: Read chip ID from register 0xD0; expected value is 0x60.
Burst read calibration coefficients from 0x88 onward; combine 8-bit registers into the documented signed/unsigned compensation words.
Read humidity calibration registers in the 0xE1..0xE7 range, using the special bit-packed layout for dig_H4 and dig_H5.
Burst read pressure, temperature, and humidity data registers; use 0xF7..0xFE for full readout.
For pressure and temperature, interpret the first six bytes as two 20-bit unsigned raw values; for humidity, use the final two bytes as a 16-bit unsigned raw value.
Use a single burst read to preserve shadowed data consistency in normal mode.

timing_constraints.name: startup_time
timing_constraints.condition: after both VDD > 1.58 V and VDDIO > 0.65 V

timing_constraints.name: power_on_reset_wait
timing_constraints.notes: The readout value is always 0x00; chip ID can be read as soon as the device finished the power-on-reset

timing_constraints.name: i2c_sck_low_pulse_hs_1v62
timing_constraints.condition: HS mode, Cb ≤100 pF, VDDIO = 1.62 V

timing_constraints.name: i2c_sck_low_pulse_hs_1v2
timing_constraints.condition: HS mode, Cb ≤100 pF, VDDIO = 1.2 V

conversion_formulae.name: temperature_from_ut
conversion_formulae.formula: Temperature is computed from the uncompensated 20-bit temperature reading together with calibration coefficients dig_T1..dig_T3 and the t_fine intermediate value.

conversion_formulae.name: pressure_from_up
conversion_formulae.formula: Pressure is computed from the uncompensated 20-bit pressure reading together with calibration coefficients dig_P1..dig_P9 and t_fine.

conversion_formulae.name: humidity_from_uh
conversion_formulae.formula: Humidity is computed from the uncompensated 16-bit humidity reading together with calibration coefficients dig_H1..dig_H6 and t_fine.

error_conditions.condition: I2C NACK on address or data phase
error_conditions.detection: If the slave NACKs during address or data transmission, abort the transaction

error_conditions.condition: status.measuring remains set beyond the expected conversion window
error_conditions.detection: Poll status register and time out if measuring does not clear within application-defined maximum wait

error_conditions.condition: Unexpected reserved bit value in config or ctrl_meas writeback verification
error_conditions.detection: If a readback check is implemented and reserved bits differ from written-zero expectation

power_states.name: sleep
power_states.description: No operation, all registers accessible, lowest power; selected after startup

power_states.name: forced
power_states.description: Perform one measurement, store results and return to sleep mode

power_states.name: normal
power_states.description: Perpetual cycling between an active measurement period and an inactive standby period

evidence_spans.snippet: The 7-bit device address is 111011x. The 6 MSB bits are fixed.
Connecting SDO to GND results in slave address 1110110 (0x76); connection it to VDDIO results in slave address 1110111 (0x77)
first the register address must be sent in write mode (slave address 111011X0). Then either a stop or a repeated start condition must be generated.
If the value 0xB6 is written to the register, the device is reset using the complete power-on-reset procedure.
The 'id' register contains the chip identification number chip_id[7:0], which is 0x60.
Data readout is done by starting a burst read from 0xF7 to 0xFC (temperature and pressure) or from 0xF7 to 0xFE (temperature, pressure and humidity).
The 8-bit registers are named calib00…calib41 and are stored at memory addresses 0x88…0xA1 and 0xE1…0xE7.
two words must always be combined in order to represent the compensation word.
Automatically set to '1' whenever a conversion is running and back to '0' when the results have been transferred to the data registers.
Controls the rate, filter and interface options of the device. Writes to the 'config' register in normal mode may be ignored.
Time to first communication after both V DD > 1.58 V and V DDIO > 0.65 V
All modes (standard, fast, high speed) are supported. SDA and SCL are not pure open-drain.
